app.name: myjournal
app.description: A quiet place to write, one page a day.
landing.title: A quiet place to write, one page a day.
landing.description: Your journal is saved as plain text files in your own Google Drive. We don't keep your writing on our servers.
landing.kicker: Private journaling in your own Drive
landing.feature.quiet.title: Quiet by design
landing.feature.quiet.body: One page a day, intentionally simple, with no extra clutter competing with your writing.
landing.feature.drive.title: Stored in your Drive
landing.feature.drive.body: Your journal lives in a plain-text folder in your own Google Drive, not in a proprietary app database.
landing.feature.recovery.title: Easy to recover
landing.feature.recovery.body: Drafts, save states, and clear messages keep your words safe even when a connection drops.

provider.local.name: Local development
help.title: Help
help.description: myjournal keeps one plain-text entry per day in your own Drive.
help.howItWorks.title: How it works
help.howItWorks.body: While this page is open, changes save after five seconds of idle typing or when the editor loses focus. You can also use Save. Recovered drafts and combined conflict text wait for your review. If a save fails, keep this page open and use Save to retry. Each entry is a UTF-8 text file in a Drive folder named myjournal. You can open, copy, or delete those files any time.
help.access.title: What it can and cannot see
help.access.body: myjournal only accesses the files and folders it creates for your journal. Files you add elsewhere in Drive are not part of the journal and are not presented in the app.
help.reconnect.title: When to reconnect
help.reconnect.body: If the app asks you to reconnect, it usually means the Google access token expired or was revoked. Your recent text stays on this device until the save succeeds again.
privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: We keep your writing where you expect it: in your own Drive.
privacy.storage: myjournal does not store your journal entries in a database on our servers. The app keeps the current sign-in cookie only for the session and uses the Drive API to read and write the files in your journal folder.
privacy.cookie: The local cookie is encrypted and private to the app. We never log entry content or whole cookies. Browser drafts stay in their tab until a successful save, sign-out, or the browser ends that tab session.
